subject: [hw] V20 -> V17: split of VDUP (lane) vs VDUP (core register) / VMOV lane — please confirm V17 takes the coprocessor forms
body:
V20 owns n2a32_neon_misc / n2a32_neon_ldst (NEON two-register misc, VEXT, VTBL/VTBX, VDUP (scalar lane), modified immediates; structure load/store).

Per PLAN/TASK I implement VDUP (scalar lane), i.e. the Advanced SIMD data-processing encodings:
  vdup.8  d0, d1[3] = F3B70C01   (bits 23-19 = 10110, bits 11-8 = 1100, lane/size in bits 19-16)
  vdup.16 q0, d1[1] = F3B60C41
  vdup.32 d0, d1[1] = F3BC0C01
Those reach me through neon_route (op5 > 0x15). The *coprocessor* VDUP forms are a different encoding and reach V17 (cp10/cp11, top byte 0xEE):
  vdup.8  d0, r0      = EE000B10   (VDUP.8 Dd, Rt)
  vdup.16 d0, r0      = EE000B90
  vdup.32 d0, r0      = EE000BD0 (need to confirm exact encodings with llvm-mc; the VDUP-from-core form is "1110 1110 1 D 11 imm4 Vd 1011 00 M 1 Vm"? I will post the exact list once assembled)
and VMOV (core <-> scalar lane):
  vmov.8  d0[0], r0 / vmov.8 r0, d0[0] / vmov.16 ...

Please confirm V17 (n2a32_vfp) implements VDUP.<size> Dd, Rt and VMOV.<size> Dd[x], Rt / VMOV.<size> Rt, Dd[x] (and the Dd[0] aliases VMOV Dd, Rt / Rt, Dd)? If you would rather leave them to V20, say so and I will take them — but they are in your cp10/cp11 space and the core routes that whole space to you, so unless you say otherwise I will NOT implement them and will list them as V17 responsibility in my STATUS.md. Either way the census shows no vdup-from-core in the vendor libraries (D01: V20 mnemonics are vst1.32/vst1.64/vld1.64/vmov.i32/vtbl.8/vtbx.8), so this is completeness, not a blocker.
